review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: About the Role We are seeking a Golang Developer with 2 to 3 years of experience to build and maintain backend services for our software platforms. You will work across the full software development life cycle, from understanding requirements and designing solutions through to coding, testing, deployment, and support in production. •   Contribute across the full SDLC: Take part in requirements discussions, technical design, development, code review, testing, release, and post-release support. Required Qualifications and Skills •   2 to 3 years of professional experience developing backend applications in Go (Golang). •   Hands-on exposure to the full SDLC, including version control with Git, code reviews, testing, and release processes. Preferred Qualifications •   Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
